_fiction_notice: EVERY system, workflow, number and organization in this file is FICTIONAL. Harbor Ridge Institute does not exist. These are illustrative fixtures for work order UIOWA-080 and contain no University of Iowa data, findings, systems or measurements.

_schema.name: string
_schema.answers: map of worksheet question_id -> value; omit or use "unknown" for not-yet-evidenced
_schema.code_surface_inventory: map of portability.SURFACES key -> count or "unknown"; omitted keys are UNKNOWN, never zero

workflows.name: Service request intake triage
workflows.narrative: Front-desk intake form. A person is on the page waiting for a routing confirmation. STRENGTH: the pre-AI keyword rule still runs and has been measured on the same items, so a degraded answer genuinely exists and benefit can be stated as a difference. GAP: the integration was built under deadline with no port, so the provider wire shape reaches six request handlers; and whether intake content may be staged into an internal queue has never been answered.

workflows.name: Retrospective document classification backfill
workflows.narrative: Bulk re-classification of a document archive. Nobody is waiting. STRENGTH: built behind a domain port from the start, so exactly one worker touches the capability and a swap can be validated by replaying recorded inputs. GAP: the non-AI baseline was never measured on the same items, so any benefit claim about this workflow is currently unfalsifiable; and the cost of reprocessing the archive when the capability version changes has never been budgeted.

workflows.name: Award eligibility narrative drafting
workflows.narrative: Drafting eligibility narratives that affect a decision about a person. STRENGTH: the unassisted drafting baseline WAS measured, and reviewer capacity was measured on reviewing drafts rather than inferred from the unaided task. GAP: that measurement is exactly what disqualifies the planned design -- peak seasonal volume is more than double measured review capacity. Whether the content may be staged internally is also still unanswered, and most of the code surface was never inventoried.

workflows.name: Deliberately malformed intake record
workflows.fiction_label: FICTIONAL - hostile-input probe, not a real candidate workflow
workflows.narrative: Present on purpose. A worksheet filled in wrongly must have OBSERVABLE handling: wrong-typed answers are discarded to UNKNOWN and listed, unexpected keys are named and ignored, and no pattern is reported as supported on the strength of answers that were thrown away.
